data.name: xrLabel2.Text
data.value:
Whole heartedly wish you a very happy birthday!
I hope you will have a wonderful day together with your friends and loved ones.
May the year ahead be exciting and rewarding for you and your family.
I would like to personally thank you for being part of the fantastic Vodafone team.
Remember to seize the moment and enjoy every life’s opportunity to the fullest!
Let’s keep winning!
Kind regards,
